Wow. $8.2 billion for a company that's about two or three years old with less than 200 employees and Nvidia just bought Hugging Face.

Why can't Intel get lucky with AI? If only Intel got lucky...

Key Points

- AMD announced that it has agreed to acquire World Labs, a San Francisco-based AI lab developing a world model, which can be used to simulate 3D environments.
- The chipmaker said on Monday that the lab was acquired for about $8.2 billion in an all-stock transaction.
- AI researchers hope that world models can help develop robots and other physically grounded artificial intelligence applications.

AMD acquiring Fei-Fei Li's World Labs AI firm in deal worth $8.2 billion

The chipmaker had previously invested in World Labs.
